guidance.statement: FY27 Iron Ore Mining target at 3.4 Million Tons

status_history.evidence: Management reiterated 3.4 MnT net usable iron ore for FY27, explaining gross mining of 4-4.25 MnT and beneficiation losses.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue guided above ₹6,000 Cr with the new pellet plant at 80-90% capacity
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 24-25% at current market levels
FY27 capex guided at ₹1,500-2,000 Cr, rising to about ₹3,000 Cr each in FY28 and FY29
FY27 iron ore mining guided at 4-4.25 MnT gross, 3.4 MnT net usable for pellets
FY27 pellet guidance at 4 MnT, of which about 3 MnT merchant
BESS first 20 GWh line commissioning from March 2027; FY28 output 5-6 GWh
CRM Complex 50% utilisation in FY28, 90% from FY29
Mining production guidance of 3.4 million tonnes for FY27 maintained.
Pellet production expected slightly lower than 4.0 million tonnes for FY27.
CRM complex commissioning targeted by December 2027.
BESS first container rollout expected in Q1FY28.
Mining cost target below ₹2,700 per tonne from FY28.

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Products > Iron & Steel Products

operating_notes.text: Completed third tranche of Ardent Steel stake sale, realizing ₹22.18 Cr for 9.24% stake and reducing total holding to 9.22%.
Wholly owned subsidiary GNEPL signed supply agreement with Roche Energy for BESS balance of system at Sambhajinagar plant.
Commissioned 25 MWp captive solar power plant at Chawardhal, Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh.
Commissioned 2.0 MnT Iron Ore Pellet Plant in Dec’25.
Q4FY26 EBITDA got about ₹20 Cr from selling 89,000 t of carryover pellet inventory and a further boost from the new pellet plant at 70% capacity.
Pellet cost of production is about ₹55-58 per tonne after beneficiation; mining-to-pellet conversion cost is about ₹2,000.
BESS container prices rose to ₹80 lakh per MWh from ₹70 lakh six months earlier; management still uses 7-8% margin for the 2031 plan.
GNEPL net worth as of March 31, 2026, is ₹298.01 Crores with NIL turnover.
Imported coal cost rose from ₹10,500/t in Q4FY26 to ₹13,000/t in Q1FY27, a 25% impact on raw material cost increase.
Pellet prices touched an all-time low of ₹8,700/t in early July 2026 and recovered to ~₹10,000/t by August.
Beneficiation plant capex of ₹218 Cr incurred till June 2026; 4.7 mt pellet capacity operated at 77% utilisation in Q1FY27.

timeline.summary: Godawari Power allotted 13,61,000 equity shares upon conversion of warrants, raising ₹25.00 Cr.
Godawari Power completed the third tranche of Ardent Steel stake sale, transferring 9.24% for ₹22.18 Cr and reducing its holding to 9.22%.
On April 23, 2026, Godawari Power announced that its subsidiary GNEPL signed a supply agreement with Roche Energy for BESS components.
On May 13, 2026, Godawari Power submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, showing ₹150.17 Cr utilized from the ₹500 Cr preferential issue.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,610.27 Cr (+9.7% YoY), net profit ₹280.23 Cr (+26.4% YoY).
Godawari Power commissioned its 25 MWp captive solar power plant at Rajnandgaon, Chhattisgarh on May 19, 2026.
Godawari Power reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹5,381 Cr and PAT of ₹802 Cr while outlining strategic expansions across mining and green energy.
Godawari Power And Ispat Limited submitted Q4FY26 conference call recording on 20.05.2026, approved by Board on 19.05.2026.
On May 21, 2026, Godawari Power completed the final tranche of its Ardent Steel stake sale, realizing ₹22.18 Cr and reducing its holding to 0.00%.

On 20 May 2026, GPIL's Q4FY26 earnings call guided FY27 revenue above ₹6,000 Cr, EBITDA margin of 24-25% and capex of ₹1,500-2,000 Cr, with the new pellet plant and Ari Dongri mining ramp as the main drivers.
On May 27, 2026, Godawari Power and Ispat Limited informed the exchange that CRISIL reaffirmed its long-term bank loan facility rating at CRISIL AA-/Stable and short-term rating at CRISIL A1+.
On June 5, 2026, Godawari Power and Ispat announced a further investment of ₹100 Cr in its wholly owned subsidiary GNEPL for a BESS plant.
Godawari Power approves ₹40 Cr inter-corporate loan to Deccan Gold Mines for Altyn Tor Gold Project

On 10 August 2026, GPIL's Q1FY27 earnings call disclosed the integrated steel plant was put in abeyance and the 0.7 mt CRM complex relocated to Maharashtra with capex raised to ₹1,100 Cr and commissioning targeted December 2027.
On 17 October 2026, Godawari Power and Ispat incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Godawari Energy Solutions Private Limited, with a ₹1 Lakh initial capital subscription.
